claim: The sample demo is isolated and does not change a real session.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /?demo=1; assert the bundled video and six WebVTT cues load above the fold, the demo banner is visible, and only IndexedDB key demo:current is written.

claim: Drop a local video and WebVTT file together to open both.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; create local copies of the bundled video and captions, dispatch one drop, and assert both named files and six cues open.

claim: Switch between all cues and dialogue only, then temporarily reveal hidden environmental cues.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; switch to Dialogue only, hold R to reveal a hidden environmental cue, and complete a dialogue practice line.

claim: The viewer labels common bracketed sound and music cues as environmental, and each cue label can be changed.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; assert the three bundled environmental cues are labelled separately, change one label, and verify the summary updates.

claim: Selecting a timed transcript cue seeks the local video to that line.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; select the 0:01 dialogue cue and assert the bundled video's current time moves to that cue.

claim: Practice mode replays one selected dialogue line and stops at its cue end.
where: Practice controls, how it works, README
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; choose the first dialogue for practice, replay it, and assert playback stops with completion feedback.

claim: Caption text, filter choice, cue changes, and practice results survive a refresh.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; change one sample cue label, wait for the demo session save, reload, and assert the changed summary is restored.

claim: The viewer sends no sample or session data to third parties.
where: First-screen facts, limits, privacy page, README
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; record every request through the sample filtering and practice flow and assert every request remains same-origin.

claim: The viewer never uploads video, captions, cue labels, or practice activity.
where: First-screen facts, file loader, privacy page, README
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; record every HTTP request while filtering, practising, loading a uniquely named local WebM and WebVTT, and saving the caption session. Assert every request is same-origin GET with no body and no local-file name or caption text in its URL or body.

claim: The viewer opens a local WebM in memory and never saves its name or bytes.
where: Session controls, limits, privacy page, README
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; select a browser-generated local WebM, inspect the separate demo session record, and assert it contains no local video filename or bytes.

claim: Export and import a caption session with changeable cue labels as JSON without rewriting the original WebVTT text.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; export after changing the filter, inspect the original VTT in the JSON, clear the session, and import that exact download.

claim: Export corrected and Dialogue only WebVTT files; Dialogue only follows changed cue labels.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /?demo=1; change one environmental cue to dialogue, download both WebVTT files, parse them, and verify the corrected file has six cues while Dialogue only has four.

claim: Caption files are limited to 5 MB.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; choose a 5 MB plus one byte WebVTT file and assert the app rejects it with a smaller-file recovery instruction.

claim: The viewer uses supplied WebVTT and does not transcribe video or retrieve captions from other services.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; assert the bundled WebVTT is used and the complete flow makes no request outside the product origin.

claim: The complete sample demo works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; wait for the service worker, reload once online, set the context offline, reload, and assert the sample cues and video remain available.

claim: The complete viewer and sample demo are free to use without an account or payment step.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; assert the free-use fact, load all six cues, and complete the dialogue filter flow without encountering account or payment controls.
